query_description: query requested from the Stathead Football Player Game Stats Finder (by the recovery operator): single games, from 2018 to 2024, started the game, played QB, in the regular season or the postseason, sorted by descending Date.
raw_row_semantics: candidate rows returned by Stathead query; not automatically accepted actual-QB starters
holdout_rule: Do not inspect or use 2025 NFL-season outcomes/starter data. Jan/Feb 2025 games belonging to the 2024 postseason are development rows, not holdout rows.
raw_preservation_rules: Preserve literal Stathead rows and anomalies.
Do not silently repair or normalize raw files in place.
Do not infer actual starter from attempts, yards, snaps, fantasy stats, result, or other target-game statistics.
Write cleaned/reconciled outputs to new versioned files.
Do not alter existing frozen historical game files.
recovery_method: manual Stathead CSV copy/paste from subscriber UI into ChatGPT conversation, then durable repository recovery
recovery_note: All literal Stathead CSV ranks 1-3921 are now committed in contiguous rank-partitioned raw files. The raw archive preserves the source output as evidence and remains uncleaned; downstream reconciliation must create new versioned files and must not alter these raw rows.

sort_order_provenance.intended_source_query_sort: sort by descending Date, as requested in the original Stathead query (see query_description)
sort_order_provenance.verified_rank_continuity: ranks 1..3921 verified contiguous with no missing or duplicate rank values
sort_order_provenance.verified_literal_row_archive: all committed raw rows preserved literally (3,921 rows; no normalization, no re-sort, no row edits)
sort_order_provenance.inversion_interpretation: localized +/-1-day rank/date micro-misplacements consistent with Stathead's per-date secondary sort / manual page-boundary behavior in a stable query; not evidence that the underlying query or export sort changed materially, and not independently proof that it stayed fixed. Rows are preserved literally; no reordering was applied.
sort_order_provenance.downstream_sort_dependency: downstream starter reconciliation must NOT rely on raw rank/date sort order; it joins raw rows to canonical games on explicit (raw Date, normalized team, opponent, location) identity.

downstream_cleaning_contract.identity_mapping: PFR ID -> nflverse player crosswalk -> canonical GSIS ID
